title: Cosmic Inflation
description: Why is the universe so flat, so smooth, and the same in every direction, even regions that could never have touched? Because a scalar field, the inflaton, made space grow by e sixty times over in 10^-32 seconds. Unlocks the Inflation Chamber and Inflaton Condensate.

puzzle.goal: A scalar field φ with potential V(φ) dominates the universe and rolls so slowly that friction from the expansion balances the slope. Each step dφ then grows space by dN = H dt e-folds. Using H² = V/(3M_P²) and 3Hφ̇ = −dV/dφ, write the number of e-folds made while the field rolls from φ down to where it stops inflating, φ_e.
puzzle.name: e-fold count of slow-roll inflation
puzzle.form: 1 / M _ P ^ 2 * int ( φ _ e , φ , V / d ( V , φ ) , φ )
puzzle.ask: For V = ½m²φ² the integrand is φ/2, so N = (φ² − φ_e²)/(4M_P²). Inflation ends when ε = 1, at φ_e = √2 M_P. With M_P = 1, find N for a start at φ.
puzzle.method: Write dN = H dt = H dφ/φ̇ and replace φ̇ by the slow-roll equation; H² and V' combine into V/V'.
